name: ORCID Import
description: Imports publications (and optionally biographies) from the ORCID public API into Bibcite references and contributors, linked to Drupal user profiles.
project_description: Imports bibliographic data from the ORCID public API (pub.orcid.org v3.0) into the Bibliography & Citation (bibcite) module. On install it adds user fields (field_orcid, field_author, field_references, field_periodicity, field_last_sync) and places an 'ORCID SYNC Button' block on user profile pages. When a user has an ORCID id stored, an 'Import publications from ORCID' form fetches all of that user's ORCID works, maps ORCID work types to Bibcite reference types, parses any BibTeX citation the work carries (renanbr/bibtex-parser), and creates or updates bibcite_reference and bibcite_contributor entities. An optional author-selection form lets an operator pick which ORCID contributor corresponds to the profile owner. The module can also import each user's ORCID biography into field_bio, run scheduled daily/weekly/monthly syncs via hook_cron, and bulk-import works/bios for all users. Drush commands are provided to bulk-delete imported references and contributors.
